name: lp-task
description: Commands /lp-task:do (tracker task → project selection → plan → branches → implementation, optionally in the autonomous lp-task-loop), /lp-task:test-browser (full browser check via Chrome MCP), /lp-task:commit (commit the task changes in all of its projects, then offer to push), /lp-task:push (push + MR/PR), /lp-task:mr-copy (copy the team MR message again) and /lp-task:init (create a project config)
